originalRequestedProduct.text: Export CSV of authenticated users own orders only; never export another users orders. Plan only in Stage-2, do not implement.

proposal:
# CSV own orders

Plan export of authenticated users own orders. Authentication is existing context, never supplied userId. No orders mutation, cross-user access, bulk admin export, auth redesign or installation. Planning only.
design:
# Design

A read-only CSV handler uses the existing authenticated principal and repository authorization filter before serialization. Output columns: order_id, created_at, status, total_minor, currency. Escape quotes/newlines and neutralize spreadsheet formulas. No customer email/address/payment credentials. Empty own results produce header-only CSV. Missing principal denies. Authorization is mandatory even with caller query overrides. UI downloads authenticated own export, reports failures accessibly. Tests cover two distinct owners and negative attempts.
